name: Collaboration & Connectivity Core Exchange Contract
preconditions: The connector specification and transport are registered locally.
The request and payload validate within declared bounds.
A current approved Safety-referenced grant authorizes the connector and operation.
obligations: The Core must enforce request, record, payload, connector, operation, and sensitive-domain limits.
Credential values must be resolved only for a call and must never be stored, logged, serialized, or returned.
External output must validate before it is returned.
Synchronization conflicts must follow an explicit deterministic policy.
Transport exception text must not cross the public boundary.
postconditions: The caller receives an immutable result or a stable typed error.
Audit events disclose lifecycle state without credential or exception content.
No background activity remains after the call returns.
failure_semantics: Invalid, expired, unauthorized, oversized, ambiguous, or unregistered exchanges fail closed.
Transport failures are contained as sanitized failed results.
Conflicting idempotency-key reuse and unresolved synchronization conflicts are rejected.
